search_seo.interpretation: Synthetic fixture: the search axis of the candidate run.

ai_visibility.interpretation: Synthetic fixture: the AI axis of the candidate run.

findings.title: Page declares a <title>

evidence.observed: The head of https://staging.example.com/a declares one <title> of 48 characters.

findings.expected: Every indexable page declares one non-empty <title>.
findings.recommendation: Keep the title unique per template.

verification.assertion: The document has exactly one non-empty <title>.

expected_impact.rationale: Google documents the title as the primary source of the search result link.

findings.title: Meta description missing
findings.recommendation: Write a description that summarises the page.

verification.assertion: The meta description length is inside the pass band.

expected_impact.rationale: Without a description the engine writes its own snippet from the page.

findings.title: rel=canonical points at another URL
findings.expected: Every indexable URL declares the canonical version of itself.
findings.recommendation: Point the canonical at the page itself unless the duplicate is intentional.

verification.assertion: The head carries exactly one self-referential rel=canonical.

expected_impact.rationale: Google documents rel=canonical as its strongest canonicalisation signal.

findings.title: og:image is missing
findings.expected: A reachable og:image of at least 200x200.
findings.recommendation: Add an og:image to the social card block.

expected_impact.rationale: Social cards affect click-through on shared links.

findings.title: Internal link returns 404

evidence.observed: 1 of 12 internal links on https://staging.example.com/e answered 404.

findings.recommendation: Repoint or remove the broken link.

expected_impact.rationale: Broken internal links waste crawl budget and lose link equity.

findings.title: LCP above the good threshold

evidence.observed: CrUX p75 LCP for the origin is 4.1 s.

findings.expected: p75 LCP at or below 2.5 s.
findings.recommendation: Reduce the largest contentful paint of the entry templates.

verification.assertion: p75 LCP <= 2500 ms for the origin.

expected_impact.rationale: Google documents Core Web Vitals as a ranking signal.

findings.title: AI crawlers are allowed at the origin root

evidence.observed: robots.txt has no Disallow that applies to GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot or Google-Extended at /.

findings.expected: The AI crawlers the site wants citations from can reach it.
findings.recommendation: Keep the posture deliberate and documented.

verification.assertion: isAllowed(robots, bot, '/') is true for each AI bot.

expected_impact.rationale: Each vendor documents the user agent it uses and honours robots.txt for it.

findings.title: Product node without offers

evidence.observed: The Product node on https://staging.example.com/only-in-b has no offers property.

findings.expected: A Product node carries offers with price and availability.
findings.recommendation: Emit offers on the product template.

verification.assertion: Every Product node has an offers property.

expected_impact.rationale: Google documents offers as required for product rich results.
